title: Uniform Property (S)
summary: We introduce and investigate a quantitative version of Steinhaus' property$(S)$ for Banach spaces, called the \emph{uniform property$(S)$}. A Banach space$X$ is said to have uniform$(S)$ if for every pair of distinct unit vectors $x,y\in X$ and every$a>0$, the difference of the perturbed norms $$ \sup_{\|z\|\le a}\big|\|x+z\|-\|y+z\|\big| $$ is bounded below by a positive function of$a$ and$\|x-y\|$. We compute this modulus exactly for the spaces $L_1(μ)$ with atomless measure$μ$, $$ U_{L_1(μ)}(d;a)=\Big(\tfrac{4a}{2+d}\wedge 1\Big)d. $$ The class of spaces with uniform$(S)$ is stable under…
